sourceLeads.name: Migrol / M-Charge
sourceLeads.note: Official current M-Charge national price bands: <22 kW CHF0.38/kWh, <64 kW CHF0.48, <200 kW CHF0.55, <400 kW CHF0.59. Site says these are M-Charge station prices. Apply only after operator/scope/power reconciliation.

sourceLeads.name: IWB
sourceLeads.note: Official public network tariffs: AC CHF0.48/kWh; DC <=50kW CHF0.60/kWh + CHF0.15/min after 150 min; DC <=150kW CHF0.64/kWh + CHF0.25/min after 60 min. Scope says public IWB network in Basel region; reconcile stations outside scope before applying.

sourceLeads.name: Plenitude On The Road
sourceLeads.note: Official pay-per-use Switzerland power-band pricing available. Also O2A roaming page publishes Swiss CPO wholesale bands. Use only direct-owned/current CH*PLN scope and distinguish retail PPU from roaming O2A.

sourceLeads.name: EPO
sourceLeads.note: Official SFOE national documentation identifies CH*EPO as EPO. No direct tariff source established yet.

sourceLeads.name: AVIA
sourceLeads.note: Official SFOE national documentation identifies CH*AVIA/AVIA; current feed code is CH*AVI in our national dataset. Alias requires evidence before automatic merge.

sourceLeads.name: EWD Elektrizitätswerk Davos AG
sourceLeads.note: Official EWD FAQ: EWD-owned public charging stations charge CHF 1.00 start fee plus CHF 0.58/kWh. EWD station page lists own public locations and payment channels. Apply only to current CH*EWD EVSEs after national identity reconciliation.

sourceLeads.name: AVIA VOLT Suisse
sourceLeads.note: Official Swiss app package ch.avia.volt, backend/service support by Deftpower. App exposes point-specific availability, power and prices. Candidate for later app/API extraction; no uniform tariff inference.

sourceLeads.name: AVIA VOLT Suisse
sourceLeads.note: Official FAQ states there is no uniform standard cost; prices vary by charge point/provider/speed and current tariffs are visible per point in the app.

sourceLeads.name: Lidl Schweiz
sourceLeads.note: Official current charging page: Lidl Plus AC CHF0.26/kWh, DC CHF0.42/kWh; web ad-hoc AC CHF0.50/kWh, DC CHF0.62/kWh. Terms state tariffs shown before the session govern and may change; use current point/type evidence, not historical extrapolation.
